races.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict: WESTERN MODEL 's latest Sligo third came in a race which has worked out really well and he's taken to open his chase account now. Il Silenzio has a solid chase record and is second choice ahead of recent Sligo hurdle winner Moorish Castle , who appeals as one likely to take to fences. WESTERN MODEL (IRE) IL SILENZIO MOORISH CASTLE (IRE)

races.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict: RATTLEDELATCH opened his chasing account in good style at Tramore last time and can add to it here at the likely chief expense of fencing newcomers Torpille Dagrostis and Good Option who are both in very good hands and bring potential. Butter Fingers completes the shortlist now back at a more suitable trip. RATTLEDELATCH (IRE) TORPILLE DAGROSTIS (FR) GOOD OPTION (IRE)

races.title: Matchbook 50/50 Series 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: BORORA AURA signed off on the Flat with a breakthrough victory at Bellewstown for Michael Mulvany and also shaped well on her hurdling debut for her new stable when third at Galway so gets the vote here. Both Blissful Bonita (second choice) and Coexist are in excellent hands and bring fair form from the Flat too so could emerge as the main dangers. BORORA AURA (IRE) BLISSFUL BONITA (IRE) COEXIST (IRE)

races.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: An ultra-competitive finale in which the vote goes to TUDORISTA , who is yet to get her head in front but Edward Power's mare is well and truly knocking on the door in recent weeks. Head For Home confirmed his return to form in a change of headgear at Down Royal 10 days ago so he rates as a threat, with Le Fanu , Westin Pimpernel and Mellem a handful of others worth considering, as well. TUDORISTA (IRE) HEAD FOR HOME (IRE) LE FANU (IRE)
